title: CrownSMP
description: An economy SMP with public bases and a Crown system. One player holds the Crown and gains powerful gear, including a mace, trident, and Speed III. Hunt down the Crown holder to steal the Crown and become the new king. PvP is encouraged.
body:
This is an Economy SMP with public bases, trading, and a unique Crown event system. At all times, one player will hold the Crown, granting them powerful gear and abilities such as an overpowered mace, a trident, and Speed III effects.

The Crown holder becomes the main target of the server. Players can team up, track them down, and battle for the Crown. If the Crown holder is killed, the Crown transfers to the player who got the kill, making them the new king with all its powerful advantages.

PvP, raids, and fights for control are part of the gameplay, but griefing or destroying public bases is not allowed. Build, trade, fight, and survive while competing to become the strongest player on the server.
